#summary Dependency Injection package inside chair/context

= Dependencies =

Depends on the autoload.

= About It: =

We tried to minimize number of external dependencies in our applications.

And came to conclusion that it can be done with one stable external dependency done as a static class which provide caller with context object. 

Context object is a container with methods associated with this context. 

Contexts described inside configuration file, which should be loaded before work with context. 

System can merge more then 1 configuration file.

= Example =

== Configuration file example ==
{{{
<contexts>
    <context name=''>
        <command name='run' class='Main' method='execute' />
    </context>
    <context name='Main'>
        <command name='start' class='Grabber' method='run' />
        <command name='output' class='Renderer' method='visualize' />
    </context>
</contexts>
}}}

== PHP Code: ==

{{{

Context_Manager::load('contexts/main.xml');

Context_Manager::getContext(__CLASS__)->run();

class Main
{
    public function execute()
    {
        $context = Context_Manager::getContext(__CLASS__);
        $context->start();
        $context->output();
    }
}

class Grabber
{
    public function run()
    {
        /* inside Grabber::run */
    }
}

class Renderer
{
    public function visualize()
    {
        /* inside Renderer::visualize */
    }
}

}}}
